items.title: [NBPA] Myles turner is elected vice-president. He joins the Executive Committee with Fred VanVleet (President), Grant Williams (First vice-president), Mason Plumlee (Secretary-Treasurer) and the other vice-presidents: Jaylen Brown, Karl-Anthony Towns, Gabe Vincent, Trey Murphy and Santi Aldama.
